olivia: Quick Q — we need a pattern for per-model runtime overrides (feature flags / max_tokens / quantization profile). Current idea: base ConfigMap + per-model ConfigMap mounted at /etc/model-configs/<model>. Any guidance on precedence, TF wiring, and how to avoid full pod restarts? Also: special considerations for Private (VPC + sealed secrets)?

sam (eng-platform): For precedence we prefer: 1) default/global config, 2) model-specific ConfigMap, 3) runtime overrides via control-plane. So model ConfigMaps should only contain things that are safe to change there (flags, small knobs). For rollout without restart we use annotation checksum pattern + a reloader sidecar OR expose an RPC config endpoint.

jia (eng-runtime): FYI runtime supports hotpatch for a subset of knobs (batch_size, prefix_cache_enabled, kv_cache_ttl) via the admin /internal/config HTTP endpoint. Changes there apply immediately.

But note: quantization profile and model weights require a model reload which currently does a graceful restart of the model worker (not whole pod) if we call the internal loader. If the change touches the model artifact or tokenizer you will need a restart.

kevin (eng-infra): Terraform notes: if you create per-model ConfigMaps, add them to the k8s_manifest module we use (do NOT inline as kubectl apply in CI). We track manifests in TF so drift is minimized. Also don't put secrets in ConfigMaps — use sealed-secrets or ExternalSecrets + KMS. Private customers need their KMS ARN in the secret manifest.

sam (eng-platform): Example deployment annotation we use to trigger reloader (helm template snippet):

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: model-xyz
  annotations:
    checksum/model-config: "{{ include (sha256 .Values.modelConfig) }}" # when this changes the reloader touches the pod
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"
    spec:
      containers: ...
```

This avoids a full cluster rollout and scopes restarts to the Deployment. If you want zero-restart behavior, push to the control plane and let the runtime pull changes via gRPC.

maya (eng-ml): Is there an existing config schema for per-model flags? I can make a small JSON schema so platform/runtime can validate.

jia (eng-runtime): We have a minimal schema in repo infra/model-config-schema.json but it's not enforced everywhere. If you can keep it small (allowed_keys: ["max_tokens", "temperature", "batch_size", "kv_cache_ttl", "quant_profile"]) that's best. For boolean feature flags prefer namespaced keys like feature.preview.experimental_sampler

olivia: Example ConfigMap I'm proposing (mounted as /etc/model-configs/model-xyz.yaml):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-xyz-config
data:
  model-xyz.yaml: |
    max_tokens: 2048
    temperature: 0.2
    feature:
      preview:
        experimental_sampler: false
    quant_profile: "q4_0"
```

kevin (eng-infra): For TF, create a k8s_manifest resource:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "model_xyz_config" {
  manifest = file("./manifests/model-xyz-config.yaml")
}
```
And reference the manifest checksum in the deployment module input so the deployment picks up the change.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for model-xyz v2 -> 10% traffic.

sam (eng-platform): One caution: when using the reloader sidecar, ensure liveness probe tolerates short restarts and that we don't evict a model-heavy pod during scheduled spikes. Use pod disruption budgets for model deployments.

maya (eng-ml): I'll open a PR that contains: 1) model-xyz ConfigMap; 2) schema validation unit test; 3) TF k8s_manifest entry; 4) helm values update to include the checksum/annotation.

olivia: Thanks — can you @sam and @kevin on the PR for infra + platform signoff? Also for Private deployments we need a note in the README about sealing the secret with the customer's KMS.

sam (eng-platform): sgtm. Also add a short integration test: run the runtime locally, POST to /internal/config with updated JSON and assert changes are visible in metrics within ~5s.

kevin (eng-infra): I'll review TF changes. If you're adding many per-model ConfigMaps we may want to batch them into a single k8s_manifest file to avoid too many small resources in state.

olivia: Action items: Maya opens PR, Sam/Jia/Keven review, Maya adds schema + test, Keven updates TF module if needed, we use reloader annotation for now and plan longer-term gRPC control-plane hooks.

maya: On it, will ping once PR is ready :thumbsup:
